body:
Since its inception in 2006, Oxford College has consistently upheld excellence in education, under the stewardship of Shri Vasant Horatti, Chairman Oxford Group of Institutions. Over the past 18 years, we have provided exceptional educational experiences in various sectors, cultivating talent and fostering innovation.

At OXFORD, we take pride in offering a comprehensive and rigorous Master of Business Administration (MBA) program to equip with the business knowledge, skills, and practical experience to excel in today's business world. The Course is full time AICTE Approved and is affiliated to the Karnataka University, Dharwad. The University is accredited ‘A++’ grade by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) and MBA programs approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi.

The MBA program offered @ OXFORD College of Business Administration, with a multi-disciplinary approach has a specialization that will open the door for career opportunities for the students. It is a full-time, two-year endeavored, spanning four semesters across, tailored to provide you with a solid foundation in business fundamentals allowing you to specialise in your chosen career like Marketing, Finance & Human Resource. It has a strong foundation in academic research, designed to tackle the real challenges that face today's international business community.

Through this programme, we facilitate our students with the necessary skills to help them make the most of the managerial opportunities. The course also lays emphasis on conceptual and analytical reasoning, soft skills, personality development, communication skills, and computer proficiency, while imparting crucial insights into the business world that demonstrates our dedication in delivering high-quality, industry-specific technical education in diverse specializations, tailored to meet the demands of today's technology-driven landscape.

**“OXFORD WE OFFER – HOLISTIC MANAGEMENT EDUCATION FOR GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT”**

**“JOIN US IN SHAPING FUTURE TECHNOLOGY LEADERS”**
